action.text: Recommendation (KI-22): A · Ledger. One quiet column is the easiest to ignore at a glance (title + one line, numbered, Today vs Earlier this week), opens in place so the batch stays in view, and works unchanged on a phone. Kin is signed once per batch; the only gold is the seam on the hunch. Desk (B) is best for deep reading on the Mac (observed and hunch side by side, clip cards) and is worth borrowing at wide widths; Letter (C) has the strongest identity but reads like a persona and is the hardest to scan. Adopt → new draft titled with a short working title, empty body, idea + clips in a side panel and in frontmatter (ideas: list, clips as wikilinks); attach drops self-links.
